free_tier.stated: 'Enclave is free for personal and home use for up to 5 systems, provided you agree to non-commercial use of the product.'

egress.terms: No byte allowance is published; the plan is priced per enrolled system at USD 8.00 per system per month MSRP.; ingress: none

interface_detail: agent install plus a licence key
chaining: a private overlay for a user's own machines, so it sits behind whatever public ingress is chosen

limits.value: The 5-system cap is the only free meter and the vocabulary has no token for a device count, so request-rate is the nearest. It is moot for this test: there is no public ingress to spend 1 TiB through.

reliability_note: the licence key is per system; a sixth system stops enrolling rather than throttling
